335:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I don't understand... What on earth for...」

335:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Just kidding! How unlike me to get all serious!」

335:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... in a situation where none of us knows what tomorrow holds, the celebration for the ace pilots will have to wait until next time.」

335:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That said, I have a dimensional merchant's grit! No matter the situation, the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ stays open for business!」

335:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then...! Here's to everyone's bright futures~! Let's give it our all again today... business, business!」

336:t_000:0.en:
$n
「$$桂$$, are you sure you'll be all right on your own?」

336:t_000:1.en:
$$桂$$
「It's been a long time since I got a turn. I'll show you what a one-man charge looks like.」

336:t_000:3.en:
$n
「Then I'll be looking forward to seeing that cool side of you too.」

336:t_000:4.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
(For now, it looks like $n is doing fine...)

336:t_000:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
(That guy... he started living with his father after his mother died, right?)

336:t_000:7.en:
$$マオ$$
(He talks a little about his dad and his sister, but he never tries to talk about the time before that.)

336:t_000:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Maybe what happened with his mom is where that quiet-type streak of his comes from...)

336:t_000:10.en:
$$カトル$$
(Miss $$スズネ$$ seems to be worried.)

336:t_000:11.en:
$$マオ$$
(But $n tries his best not to let the down side of his heart show. He's growing.)

336:t_000:12.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Here they come...! All units, stay alert!」

336:t_001:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh... hello, it's been a while.」

336:t_001:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「What a misfortune for you this time. To have most of your comrades thrown all the way out into the far reaches of outer space.」

336:t_001:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So you see through our circumstances.」

336:t_001:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, this is nothing much. The $$サイデリアル$$ operate across the entire galaxy, but our main force is in the galactic core.」

336:t_001:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「In other words, you guys got shipped off to the frontier for some do-nothing post, huh?」

336:t_001:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「You're too modest. Surely you know that this Earth holds enough power to decide the fate of the galaxy.」

336:t_001:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Which is why, while our numerical strength is at the galactic core, our qualitative strength... the so-called elite... has been dispatched here.」

336:t_001:8.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「After all, His Majesty $$アウストラリス$$, who leads the $$サイデリアル$$, is here with us.」

336:t_001:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「With the ruler of the $$サイデリアル$$ on Earth, that man's words are probably no lie.」

336:t_001:11.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Then I ask. Why are the $$サイデリアル$$ hostile to the $$マーティアル$$?」

336:t_001:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「It seems they simply can't stand the god that everyone over there worships. I don't know the details, though.」

336:t_001:13.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Sorry about that. That's what middle management is like, yes.」

336:t_001:14.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$サルディアス$$... Seeing those Reactors and you, I can believe the claim that it's the elite who have come to Earth.」

336:t_001:15.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But judging by that $$ギルター$$, the level of the $$サイデリアル$$ as a whole doesn't seem all that high.」

336:t_001:16.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「As expected of you, $$ゼロ$$. I can't argue if you bring that up.」

336:t_001:17.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「In that case, for the pride of the $$サイデリアル$$, I'll have to show you what we're really made of.」

336:t_001:18.en:
$n
「So that's how it's going to be...!」

336:t_001:20.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh, $$特異点$$! I wondered why I couldn't find you anywhere, and here you were!」

336:t_001:21.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「How lucky. Then allow me to dispose of you all at once.」

336:t_001:22.en:
$$桂$$
「Not on your life! I finally came out, and if it's over right away, I'd be no better than a cicada!」

336:t_001:23.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin the attack! Intercept the enemy and protect $$スコート・ラボ$$!」

336:t_001:24.en:
$$カレン$$
($$エスター$$... We'll protect the lab, the place that means so much to you!)

336:t_002:0.en:
$$カトル$$
「Be careful! Enemy reinforcements are coming!」

336:t_003:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That battleship... $$ダバラーン・タウ$$!」

336:t_003:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, well, General $$ダバラーン$$... What brings you here?」

336:t_003:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Forgive me, General $$サルディアス$$. I have no intention of trampling on your battlefield, but something has come up that leaves us no choice.」

336:t_003:3.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Are you saying Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ is coming?」

336:t_003:4.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Yes... She will be here in about six minutes.」

336:t_003:5.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$ストラウス$$, the $$欲深な金牛$$...!」

336:t_003:6.en:
$$五飛$$
「Why is the commander of all $$新地球皇国$$ forces here...!?」

336:t_003:7.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「What do we do, $$ゼロ$$?」

336:t_003:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...It's dangerous to take on a Reactor with our current forces.」

336:t_003:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Luckily, the townspeople and the lab staff have been evacuated. We'll fight all-out until $$ストラウス$$ arrives, then fall back!」

336:t_003:10.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Not so fast...! We'll dispose of you before the Supreme Commander arrives!」

336:t_003:11.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「And this facility, where there are those who defy the Empire, we'll burn to the ground, and...」
